name: session-viewer
description: Scan, inspect, and compare local Codex or Claude Code sessions in a private, read-only browser dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Codex and Claude Code sessions
interface.longDescription: Launches a local-only, read-only dashboard with separate Codex and Claude Code sources. It reports persisted prompt or context metrics, compares two sessions from the selected source, and presents each turn as query, thinking, tool calls, and tool results.
defaultPrompt: Launch the local session trace dashboard
